title: reputation.py Phase B: EMA decay and operational-consequence engine BEHIND AN ACTIVATION FLAG
description: Build the coupling the valley has and PR-060 permits: EMA reputation decay feeding claim priority ordering, iteration bounds and worker slot allocation - OPERATIONAL parameters only, exactly the three PR-061 names. NO STAKING (D-17: no asset boundary). The engine ships with activation OFF and a guard test asserting it cannot activate while PR-061's authority is unresolved; constitutional parameters (decay rate, weights, thresholds) read from an operator-owned file that agents cannot legislate.

notes.note: HANDOFF -> verifier: T-420 built: the Phase B constitutional gate. Design: under D-17 the only boundary any agent cannot cross is the operator's off-machine private key, so activation and constitutional parameters live ONLY in .harness/constitutional/reputation.json + detached ssh signature, verified against the enrolled trust anchor (warrant.check_anchor reused as-is; NEW namespace harness-constitutional, never harness-warrant). dispatch (the one consequence verb) refuses unless the file VERIFIES and says activation on, and takes half-life/weights from the signed payload only; --half-life-days on dispatch is refused outright even when it agrees with the file. rank stays a consequence-free report, accepts trial params, labels them ratified/NOT RATIFIED. audit-immunity rewritten: the hardcoded six-True PASS dict is gone; it now reports mechanical figures (file state, activation, signed vs default params) and labels the rest NOT MECHANICALLY EVALUABLE with reasons, NO verdict (currency.py precedent). Evidence: pytest .harness/tests/test_reputation_phase_b.py -q -> 28 passed (was 6); full suite 786 passed, 4 skipped. Attack tests use REAL keys: absent/unsigned/wrong-key/wrong-namespace/tampered/activation-off/unenrolled all refuse; signed weights provably reach the score (3x weight -> 3x score); AST test pins the exhaustive map of write-capable calls to exactly one (allowed_signers rebuild in system temp dir) and that no ssh-keygen -Y mode other than verify appears. Zero-writes snapshot extended to every Phase B verb including activated dispatch. Bootstrap: before enrollment the gate is CLOSED (UNVERIFIABLE), not open. Files: .harness/bin/reputation.py, .harness/tests/test_reputation_phase_b.py. Verify hints: try to activate without the operator key; try to smuggle a param via CLI/env; check the AST map is exhaustive (not an allow-set that rots); check rank cannot be consumed as a gate.
